Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived at read time as the title, a
                single space, and the last name (e.g. 'DR Franklin'). When no
                title was supplied it is just the last name.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'DR Franklin'
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes. For
                example '+61412345678' is displayed as '+61 412 345 678'. The
                raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form. Derived at read time.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member id, formatted
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' where REGION is the region derived
                from the postcode (falling back to a city-to-region table, else
                'UNKNOWN'), FY is the two-digit fiscal year (starting 1 July) of
                the business-day-adjusted registration date, HASH8 is the first
                8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the
                normalized E.164 telephone concatenated with the last name, and
                CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. Assigned at creation; carries no sequence
                number (a collision is de-duplicated with a '-<n>' suffix).
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW271A2B3C4D5'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last
                two digits of the fiscal year (which starts on 1 July) of the
                business-day-adjusted registration date. A registration on or
                after 1 July belongs to the fiscal year ending in the following
                calendar year. Derived at read time.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'FY27'
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier derived deterministically from the
                owner's last name and postcode (the first 12 hex characters of
                the SHA-256 digest of the normalized last name and the postcode).
                It is assigned to every owner automatically, so all owners with
                the same last name and postcode share the same value.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key: the lower-case
                SHA-256 hex (64 characters) of the normalized E.164 telephone,
                the lower-cased email (or empty when none), and the American
                Soundex code of the last name, joined with '|'. A create is
                rejected with 409 when a new owner's whole identity key equals an
                existing owner's (ignoring owners flagged deleted); because the
                telephone is part of the key, two members of the same household
                with different telephones have different keys and are both
                allowed (the second is instead flagged as a possible duplicate).
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '3b1f8c...'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively). Assigned at creation and
                returned on read.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's derived membership points. Starts at 0; add 2 when
                an email address is present; add 1 when the owner has no
                namesakes (namesakeCount is 0); add 2 when the owner belongs to
                a household of 3 or more; add 3 when the owner's tenure is at
                least one elapsed fiscal year (fiscal years start 1 July). A
                newly created owner has zero tenure, so a new owner
                with an email and no namesakes in a single-member household
                scores 3 points.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 3
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's derived membership level, a number from 1 to 4
                mapped from membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3
                for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              readOnly: true
              example: 2
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's region, taken from the leading '<REGION>' segment of
                the memberId (everything before its trailing FY, HASH8 and CHK
                segments). The region is derived from the postcode at creation
                (falling back to a fixed city-to-region table, else 'UNKNOWN'),
                so the locality moves with the owner's region-and-hash identity.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW'
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, derived at read time and
                formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when
                membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is
                'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD),
                otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived at read time from the
                locality/region via a fixed region-to-timezone table:
                NSW -> Australia/Sydney, VIC -> Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD -> Australia/Brisbane. Absent when the region resolves to
                no entry in the table.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived at read time:
                'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'EMAIL'
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived at read time from the birthDate
                relative to the registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18,
                'ADULT' when 18 to 64, 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Absent when
                no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              readOnly: true
              example: 'ADULT'
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, more than 80
                owners had already been created for the current day; otherwise
                false. Assigned at creation and returned on read.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, its city already
                held between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the per-city capacity
                limit of 50); otherwise false. Assigned at creation and returned
                on read.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, it was not a hard
                (identity-key) duplicate yet shared an existing owner's last name
                and postcode while carrying a different telephone; otherwise
                false. Assigned at creation and returned on read.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner was flagged as a possible
                duplicate of (the owner whose last name and postcode it shares).
                Present only when 'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              readOnly: true
              example: 1
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner
                is false. DELETE /api/owners/{id} sets this true and retains the
                record (the owner is still returned on read). Owners flagged
                deleted are ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and
                identity checks.
              type: boolean
              readOnly: true
              example: false
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical URI path of this owner resource, formatted
                '/api/owners/<id>' where <id> is the owner's id. Derived at
                read time.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '/api/owners/1'
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner. When supplied it must
            be one of MR, MRS, MS or DR. Used to compose the derived
            'salutation'. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility with the flat address form. On read this holds the
            composed address: the normalized 'addressLine1', with a single
            space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended when an
            'addressLine2' was supplied. Optional on create when structured
            'addressLine1' is supplied instead.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: "(?s).*\\S.*"
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address
            (e.g. street number and name). Preferred over the flat 'address'
            when supplied; normalized on create with the same rules as
            'address' (trimmed, internal whitespace collapsed, upper-cased,
            common street-type abbreviations expanded).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: "(?s).*\\S.*"
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address (e.g. unit or apartment). When supplied it is normalized
            with the same rules as 'addressLine1' and appended to the composed
            'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: "(?s).*\\S.*"
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: "(?s).*\\S.*"
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped;
            a leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise country code '+61'
            is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national
            digits. The result must be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits; this
            E.164 value is stored and returned. For example '0412 345 678' is
            stored as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must
            be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; when supplied it must be
            exactly four digits and, when the city has a known region (Sydney
            -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC, Brisbane -> QLD), fall within that
            region's inclusive range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD
            4000-4099). A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit
            postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. The stored value is returned on read.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' form. Optional;
            when supplied it is stored and returned, and drives the derived
            'ageBand' (computed against the registration date).
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even if another owner already
            has the same last name and postcode (same household); the new owner
            is then created as a declared household member and is not flagged as
            a possible duplicate. Without it a second owner in the same household
            is rejected with 409. Write-only flag used only on create; it is
            never stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'Franklin, George'
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'G.F.'
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived at read time as the title, a
                single space, and the last name (e.g. 'DR Franklin'). When no
                title was supplied it is just the last name.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'DR Franklin'
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone (display)
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes. For
                example '+61412345678' is displayed as '+61 412 345 678'. The
                raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form. Derived at read time.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member id, formatted
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' where REGION is the region derived
                from the postcode (falling back to a city-to-region table, else
                'UNKNOWN'), FY is the two-digit fiscal year (starting 1 July) of
                the business-day-adjusted registration date, HASH8 is the first
                8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 digest of the
                normalized E.164 telephone concatenated with the last name, and
                CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. Assigned at creation; carries no sequence
                number (a collision is de-duplicated with a '-<n>' suffix).
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'NSW271A2B3C4D5'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last
                two digits of the fiscal year (which starts on 1 July) of the
                business-day-adjusted registration date. A registration on or
                after 1 July belongs to the fiscal year ending in the following
                calendar year. Derived at read time.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'FY27'
            householdId:

                owner's last name and postcode (the first 12 hex characters of
                the SHA-256 digest of the normalized last name and the postcode).
                It is assigned to every owner automatically, so all owners with
                the same last name and postcode share the same value.
              type: string
              readOnly: true
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-

                SHA-256 hex (64 characters) of the normalized E.164 telephone,
                the lower-cased email (or empty when none), and the American
                Soundex code of the last name, joined with '|'. A create is
                rejected with 409 when a new owner's whole identity key equals an
                existing owner's (ignoring owners flagged deleted); because the
                telephone is part of the key, two members of the same household
                with different telephones have different keys and are both
                allowed (the second is instead flagged as a possible duplicate).

              readOnly: true

            namesakeCount:

                an email address is present; add 1 when the owner has no

                a household of 3 or more; add 3 when the owner's tenure is at
